body:
Founder real-time: "fatbaby publishes the same bac ben ba amzn F governance story over and over" /
"press releases page is not updating" / "i should see all tickered press releases".

Two real, distinct bugs found and fixed:

1. internal/newssite/handler.go's serveWire called docIdx.Recent(100) (top 100 docs across ALL
   types) then filtered for SourceType=="press_release" -- on any day with 100+ more-recent SEC
   filings, real press releases got truncated away before the filter ever ran. Fixed: new
   docindex.RecentByType(sourceType, n) filters BEFORE truncating. Real regression tests added
   (TestRecentByType_FiltersBeforeTruncating reproduces the exact failure shape).

2. Bigger finding: NOTHING in the pipeline ever wrote a source_document_persisted event for a
   press release at all. eps-processor/dividend-watcher/guidance-watcher/buyback-watcher each
   read pr_body_fetched independently for their own specialized extraction, but none fed a
   general SourceDocument back to docindex -- confirmed via `grep -rl source_document_persisted
   var/*`: only var/secwatch, none ever in var/prwatch-body, most recent dated 2026-08-12. The
   handful of "press releases" /wire WAS showing were leftover mislabeled SEC filings from an
   unrelated, already-fixed 2026-07-19 bug (sourceTypeForForm's old wrong default) -- explaining
   the "same governance story over and over" complaint exactly.

   Fixed: new cmd/pr-indexer, joins pr_discovered's PrimaryTicker (regex-extracted from
   (EXCHANGE:TICKER) mentions in body text -- prwatch/tickers.go's own extractor was already
   correct, just never consumed downstream) with pr_body_fetched's body via PRDiscoveryID,
   persists a real source_document_persisted event (SourceType "press_release") into
   var/secwatch, same store newssite already reads. Mirrors guidance-watcher's own structure
   exactly. New systemd unit fatbaby-pr-indexer.service, enabled and verified live: one-shot run
   found 31 real backlog items immediately, ongoing run caught up to 242, /press-releases now
   shows fresh press_release:<id> entries dated today instead of stale CIK-format identities from
   6+ months ago.

Real gap NOT fixed here, flagged honestly: press releases whose ticker mention falls outside
prwatch's regex scan window still can't be indexed at all (no ticker = no index, by design,
since docindex.Ingest itself drops empty-ticker docs) -- multi-ticker press releases are also
only indexed under PrimaryTicker (refs[0], not necessarily the "true" subject), not every ticker
in AllTickers. Both real, separate, smaller follow-ups.

go test ./... all green. Commits: <pending, see git log>.
title: Fixed newssite press-releases pipeline: added pr-indexer, fixed truncate-before-filter bug
